chapter.heading: God’s Charge Against Israel
chapter.v:
Hear the
word of the Lord,You children of Israel,For the Lord brings a charge against the inhabitants of the land:“There is no truth or mercyOr knowledge of God in the land.

By swearing
and lying,Killing and stealing and committing adultery,They break all restraint,With bloodshed upon bloodshed. [Gen. 11:31,] [Acts 22:1 b Ps. 29:3; 1 Cor. 2:8]

Therefore the
land will mourn;And everyone who dwells there will waste awayWith the beasts of the fieldAnd the birds of the air;Even the fish of the sea will be taken away. [Gen. 12:1]

“Now let
no man contend, or rebuke another;For your people are like those who contend with the priest. [Gen. 11:32] [Gen. 11:31; 15:7; Heb. 11:8-10]

Therefore you
shall stumble in the day;The prophet also shall stumble with you in the night;And I will destroy your mother. [Gen. 12:7;]

My people
are destroyed for lack of knowledge.Because you have rejected knowledge,I also will reject you from being priest for Me;Because you have forgotten the law of your God,I also will forget your children. [Gen. 15:13, 14, 16; 47:11, 12 i Ex. Gal. 3:17]

“The more
they increased,The more they sinned against Me;I will change their glory into shame. [Gen. 15:14 k Ex. 14:13-31 l Ex. 3:12; Josh. 3:1-17]

They eat
up the sin of My people;They set their heart on their iniquity. [Gen. 17:9-14] [Gen. 25:21-26] [Gen. 21:1-5]

And it
shall be: like people, like priest.So I will punish them for their ways,And reward them for their deeds. [Gen. 37:28 s Gen.] [Gen. 37:4, 11, 28; Ps. 105:17]

For they
shall eat, but not have enough;They shall commit harlotry, but not increase;Because they have ceased obeying the Lord.The Idolatry of Israel [Gen. 41:38-44]

“Harlotry, wine,
and new wine enslave the heart. [Gen. 41:54;]

My people
ask counsel from their wooden idols,And their staff informs them.For the spirit of harlotry has caused them to stray,And they have played the harlot against their God. [Gen. 42:1,]

They offer
sacrifices on the mountaintops,And burn incense on the hills,Under oaks, poplars, and terebinths,Because their shade is good.Therefore your daughters commit harlotry,And your brides commit adultery. [Gen. 45:4,]

“I will
not punish your daughters when they commit harlotry,Nor your brides when they commit adultery;For the men themselves go apart with harlots,And offer sacrifices with a ritual harlot.Therefore people who do not understand will be trampled. [Gen. 45:9,] [Gen. 46:26, 27; Deut. 10:22]

“Though you,
Israel, play the harlot,Let not Judah offend.Do not come up to Gilgal,Nor go up to Beth Aven,Nor swear an oath, saying, ‘As the Lord lives’— [Gen. 49:33; Ex. 1:6] [Gen. 46:1-7]

“For Israel
is stubbornLike a stubborn calf;Now the Lord will let them forageLike a lamb in open country. [Gen. 50:13; Ex. 13:19; Josh. 24:32 c Gen. 23:16]

“Ephraim is
joined to idols,Let him alone. [Gen. 15:13; Ex. 2:23-25; Acts 7:6, 7 e Ex. 1:7-9; Ps. 105:24,]

Their drink
is rebellion,They commit harlotry continually.Her rulers dearly love dishonor. [Ex. 1:8]

The wind
has wrapped her up in its wings,And they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices. [Ex. 1:22]
